source: Latest owner instruction 2026-10-14: 全部暂停，然后上传GitHub。
owner_quotes: 继续做其他的，我要用自己电脑了（hadan）
那么就永久记住吧，继续研究，我认为可以开放更多subagent，提升效率，也可以交给hadan的codex来承担一些研究任务（仅限开机时），在paseo文件夹里做也可以
仅限开机且状态是ready的情况下
关于我的电脑hadan，你可以定时监控，或者设定开启和关闭的信息会发给你；暂定中国工作日白天一般可用，以实际开机情况为准
我没有说全平台训练暂停，是保持的，所以是可以恢复的。如果有足够好的训练资源的话，现在就是恢复的，因为已经连上我的本机了。只要你检测到我的 hadan 是开启的，你就可以使用。没有说现在是暂停的呀
Hadan可随时pause或关机，工作日白天只是大概率可用；训练下次能从checkpoint继续最好，不能则重新训练也OK，千万别做复杂恢复系统。

hadan.reason: Owner paused research at quota 83%; retain checkpoints, no new remote job
required_conditions: current successful Paseo connection to endpoint hadan; online is operational evidence of power, not a wake command
worker.usage_ok=true and actual C:\paseo usage strictly below 50GiB
workspace and all task inputs/outputs/temp under C:\paseo
manifest-bound approved scope, applicable research gates and existing resource budgets
allowed: Manifest-bound existing approved research when fresh preflight ready, usage_ok and total usage below50GiB under C:\paseo.
forbidden: wake-on-LAN or powering on the owner computer
unmanifested transfers or paths outside C:\paseo
treating cancelled experiment admission manifests as valid without current-scope input/resource acceptance
hadan.unavailable_action: No remote work while offline/paused/hard_off/unknown; use an independently admitted existing server/cloud route without new spending.

availability_monitoring.preferred_check_window: Chinese working-day daytime; provisional Mon-Fri09:00–19:00 Asia/Shanghai
availability_monitoring.availability_source: successful live worker readiness, never calendar alone
availability_monitoring.permission_basis: Owner correction explicitly authorizes suitable-resource training; monitoring alone grants no new permission.

interruption_policy.availability: Owner may pause or power off at any time; calendar daytime is only a probability, not readiness.
interruption_policy.state: Use native framework checkpoints and completed shards with fixed experiment configuration, seed and model/data versions.
interruption_policy.retention: Keep the latest complete checkpoint and completed shards under total C:\paseo/50GiB; retain the only valid checkpoint during a recoverable interruption.
interruption_policy.resume: After online and fresh ready, inspect the old job/process/output. Use native resume if supported, otherwise same-definition rerun or continue completed shards.
interruption_policy.accounting: Retain cumulative time, cost, model fits/optimizer updates and trial exposure; no quota reset by renaming or rerunning.
interruption_policy.cleanup: Only after verified return/completion or explicit abandonment; do not mechanically remove the only unreturned checkpoint.
limits: No complex recovery system or new daemon
Disconnection does not prove checkpoint or stop succeeded

grpo.model_download_or_load_conditions: Only model/version/files bound to a valid current admission manifest under the existing usage/spending caps; do not reuse withdrawn B-T execution definitions.

not_automatically_authorized: new source acquisition beyond exhausted caps
labels or training datasets without scoped data-preparation admission

remote_pause_receipt.scope: known GRPO job paths, not a claim about unrelated applications

supersedes.scope: Continuing global training/optimizer/preparation-only hold is superseded by latest owner resource-conditional training authorization. Historical withdrawals, results, caps and device controls remain auditable.

training.scope: Research training on suitable resources already admitted by the owner; no new provider spending.
required_conditions: Current resource suitability and project memory/usage caps
Valid existing research plan, accepted inputs and applicable gates; routine recovery reuses approvals
Current cumulative compute/time/cost/trial budgets, no resets
Hadan additionally requires online, fresh remote preflight ready, usage_ok=true, actual usage<50GiB, all paths C:\paseo, and owner device switches respected
does_not_authorize: New spending or a new paid provider
Automatic device wake, resume, hard-on or bypassing local pause/hard_off
Resurrection of withdrawn experiment definitions or cancelled admission manifests
Broker writes, production or changes to frozen criteria

pause_reason: Owner requests all research paused at 83% quota; no quick credible weekly-goal completion selected.
release_condition: Explicit owner resumption; no automatic resume on capacity or device events.
